csv_scope_of_work: The District is requesting qualifications from firms to provide a full range of services as Construction Manager at-Risk (CMaR) during the planning, design, and construction phases for capital improvements, construction and consulting services on District facilities, and projects outlined in Appendix A. The District has retained a design firm, incite Design Studio (iDS) and their consultant team to provide architectural and engineering related services, and the CMaR will be required to work with the District and design team during the planning phase, construction documentation phases, and the construction process.
